Crossnote's electron-webview/preload.js identifies this project as the source
of its modified postMessage bridge. The upstream package supplies the ISC
identifier in package.json but has no separate licence file. The standard
ISC permission and disclaimer text follows; the original attribution in
the copied source must be retained.
